conclusion.frameOwnerIsDistinct: The registered-surface exporter selects geometric donor from the selected current parent tetrahedron, but independently derives the frame owner as the dominant interpolated full86 binding. It records rows where those differ.
conclusion.sourceMassIsDistinct: Compiled parent source mass is reconstructed from actual node/material/source-donor contribution rows. Transport keeps this CSR source-donor ledger separate from the parent cell geometric donor.
conclusion.currentTransportConstraint: Spatial mass transport partitions capacities and flow by material, cell donor, and anatomical region; it additionally checks source-donor mass closure by material and source donor. Therefore current group constraints are stronger than source-donor closure alone.
conclusion.physicalMeaning: The geometric donor is not merely a pose/frame selector: parent labels are recovered from original registered source-vertex donor labels and retained with stable source-face ancestry. The examined code does not establish that this label directly owns material parameters; density bounds are material-indexed. Existing source/topology provenance may still justify maintaining the group partition.
conclusion.disposition: Keep the existing material/geometric-donor/region partition unchanged for this work. Do not remove the donor group absent an explicit owner-semantic decision and paired invariance/negative tests.

invarianceTestsRequiredBeforeAnyFutureCh: Freeze parent/child geometry, material/region labels, coordinates, source contributions and source-face ancestry; vary only frame-owner mapping and require unchanged mass output.

If later comparing a model without the geometric-donor grouping, check per-material/per-source-donor mass and first moments, density bounds, closure, distance limits, deterministic flow and receipts on identical geometry.
Keep rejection cases for wrong material/region, invalid source donor, bad source-face ancestry and nonclosing source ledger.

evidence.finding: Source-donor split is explicitly separate; grouping and closure use material/donor/region; source closure uses material/source-donor.
Actual source contributions feed source splits; geometric cell labels feed group transport and dominant-parent checks.
Pose-frame donor and geometric donor are separate fields; inferred parent geometric donor/region must match the selected parent tetrahedron.
Parent donor is a dominant label recovered from three original registered source vertices and retained with source-face ancestry.
Geometric parent donor comes from nearest same-material parent registration; frame owner comes separately from dominant full86 weights, and mismatches are counted.
